description: This file defines PlayerActivity, an Android activity that implements a full-screen media player using ExoPlayer with custom UI controls, immersive mode, and media playback management.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages ExoPlayer to play media streams with immersive UI, custom controls, and lifecycle handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, reads intent extras, sets up UI elements, and prepares for media playback.

methods.name: wireControllerButtons
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to controller buttons like settings and fullscreen/exit.

methods.name: attachControllerListenersIfPresent
methods.description: Finds controller buttons and sets their click listeners.

methods.name: setupUnifiedControllerAnimations
methods.description: Configures animations for showing/hiding the media controls group with consistent easing.

methods.name: animateControllerGroup
methods.description: Runs fade-in/out animations on control group with specified easing and duration.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Creates and prepares ExoPlayer instance for media playback.

methods.name: enterImmersiveMode
methods.description: Sets system UI flags for full-screen immersive experience.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method; initializes player on API >= 24.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores immersive mode and initializes player on API < 24.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Disables immersive mode, releases resources on API < 24.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Releases player and triggers activity exit with fade transition.
